precepts.text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
precepts.point: Their visage is blacker than a coal, their skin cleaveth to their bones: already black, and blacker in famine; we become hypermelanated when deprived, while the white man gets lighter, and Native Americans in Alaska are still brown, so the cold-climate doctrine is stupid.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
“Their visage is blacker than a coal”: their visage means their faces. It was already black; now it is blacker than a coal. “they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.” That is because of the famine, and Lamentations 5:10 says so: “Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.”

During a famine, when our people become malnourished or deprived of food and water, we become hypermelanated. Our skin gets darker because of the effects of famine. When white folks undergo famine, their lack of melanin heightens, and they become lighter than what they already are. So we got blacker because of the famine.

That also knocks down the doctrine that white people moved to a cold climate and that is how they became white. No, they were always that way. And the other side of it, that living on a black continent changed our complexion, is dumb, stupid science. Native Americans moved to Alaska and they are still brown. White people have been living over here since the 1700s; have any of them turned black? It is stupid doctrine.

So Lamentations proves the Israelites were already a black people, whose faces went blacker than a coal in the siege, not a white people darkened by the sun or turned pale by the cold.

precepts.text: O daughter of Edom, the cup shall pass unto thee; the punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion.
precepts.point: Our eyes failed for our vain help; we watched for a nation that could not save us. Trump despises the Latinos who serve him.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
“We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians”: the Egyptians and the Assyrians represent the oppressor. Who is our oppressor today? Our main oppressor is Esau. How do we know? “Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz”. Edom is the so-called white man; that is his biblical name.

“the cup also shall pass through unto thee”: that cup of affliction, that cup of oppression, is going to pass unto them. “thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.” His evil is being revealed. This is the beginning of that; we have not seen nothing yet.

Read on: “The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity”. Our punishment is coming to an end. We are not going into slavery anymore; this one here in America is our last and final captivity. Now it is time for us to wake up and rise up like God's army that we are.

“he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” God is going to judge Esau for the evil they have done to his people. Everything this devil does is going to be revealed, and his judgment for it. So the hand we have given to the oppressor for bread is the hand of Edom, and the cup he made us drink is passing to him.

precepts.text: We have watched for a nation that could not save us.
precepts.point: Our eyes failed for our vain help; we watched for a nation that could not save us. Trump despises the Latinos who serve him.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
We gave the hand to the Egyptians “to be satisfied with bread”: if I work hard, if I send my children to their school, if I learn English, I can assimilate; if I work hard for the white man, I've made it. No. Lamentations 4:17: “As for us”, as for Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help”. Our lying help. Esau is not here to help us; they have deceived us.

“in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” They don't want no parts of us, and they can't save us, no matter how hard we try. Look at the Latinos who stand with Trump: look how Donald Trump looks at him like he is a dumbass, and the other one is not even looking at him, because he is a clown. They despise you. They just use you to deceive your people and to betray your people.

Just because they let one get through, one Diddy, one Jay-Z, and give him millions, that is chump change compared to the destruction caused when our people are led astray into thinking this is the way of life, that this is our kingdom, that we can assimilate.

There is none that doth deliver us out of their hand. Hugo Chavez couldn't do it, Fidel Castro couldn't do it, Maduro couldn't do it, even with Russian helicopters and Chinese spyware; his Cuban guards went back to Cuba in little boxes. No man can save us. Our job, brothers and sisters, is to keep God's commandments and the faith of Christ. That is our power. When we do that, the Most High and his angels will fight for us, and we must see ourselves in these scriptures, no longer as blacks or Latinos but as one people, one nation.

precepts.text: In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
precepts.point: We have given the hand to the Egyptians to be satisfied with bread, and watched for a nation that could not save us.
precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.” Look at what is happening to us. “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” The Bible calls these nations, particularly the white man, strangers and aliens. America takes that term and puts it on Issachar, the Mexicans, on our people from Venezuela, the tribe of Asher, and on our people from Haiti, the tribe of Levi. But they are the real aliens the Bible speaks of; they take our lands and homes.

They kill our fathers and our leaders, so “We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.” Water, which is to be free, they take, bottle and sell to us; the wood of our lands they chop up and sell as merchandise, carpentry, homes and tables. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.” Egypt had long been taken down when Jeremiah said this, so the Egyptian here means the oppressor, an oppressive state; Egypt and Assyria were both major oppressors. We have given our hand to the oppressor for him to give us bread.

Then Lamentations 4:17: “As for us”, the 12 tribes of Israel, “our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” We have watched for America to save us, and God is saying, they cannot save you, just as ancient Egypt could not save us and Assyria could not save our people. We keep looking for salvation to the very nations that oppress us. God said, you are wasting your time with that thing.

precepts.text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
precepts.point: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine. It is literal, not only a condition.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

precepts.why:
Lamentations 4:7 shows Israel before: “Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk”. Whiter means holier, more righteous. “more ruddy in body than rubies”: ruddy in body means healthy in body, strong and precious. Then Babylon came, cut off the food supply and starved them out. Verse 7 is the before and verse 8 is the after: “Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.” Their faces could not be recognised from verse 7; they went from ruddy in body to skin hanging off their bones.

Lamentations 5:10 says it plainly: “Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.” What caused the famine? The Babylonians surrounded us, besieged us, cut off our food and water supply, and starved us for years before conquering us entirely. Through starvation we got darker, blacker than a coal.

Why darker? When black folks go through a famine and are starved, there is a thing called hyperpigmentation: they get darker. When white folks get starved, they get lighter; they don't get darker than a coal, they get more pinker than a pig. A plant has its own melanin, chlorophyll, that gives it the green colour; deprive it of water and sunlight and it turns brown and withers, like the Jews here. They were starved and got darker than they already were.

They say it is only talking about the condition the people were in. Yes, it is a condition. When they call us black people today, they mean our condition too, because the black man is the lowest people on this earth today, and the Chinese and the Arabs are above us. But it also means our skin colour. So is our skin symbolic too? “Our skin was black like an oven”, and ovens are black. Stop playing with us.

We bring scripture, history, records from the 1600s, even science, and still they won't accept it, while all the white man has to say is he's white and they say praise Jesus. That is white makes right. The Bible alone is enough: the Israelites were black, and the famine made them blacker.

precepts.text: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them.
precepts.point: The system of America was always written against the slaves.
precepts.why:
Lamentations says, “in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” Isaiah says the same of Israel leaning on a nation: “They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

Our people watch for a nation, America, to save them. It is 2025 and we are still thinking this place is for us. What we don't understand is that the system was never built for us; it was always written against us. Think about it: when the system was built, where were we? We were in slavery. So what makes you think that same system is now going to benefit you? That was never the purpose behind it.

Donald Trump is showing you that. That is why I love Donald Trump: he is forcing the negro to see the system for exactly what it is. The system was never built for the slaves; it was always against the slaves.

So the nation Israel watched for could not profit them. It could be no help and no profit, only a shame and a reproach. Our eyes fail for a vain help as long as we look to America to save us.

precepts.text: In captivity we watched in vain for a nation that could not save us.
precepts.point: The Most High tells Isaiah to write it in a table and note it in a book for a time to come forever, because these things were written for our learning.

note.label: Isaiah 30: Woe to the Rebellious Children Who Trust in Egypt

precepts.why:
Israel carried “their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them. For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose”. The same thing happened in the Babylonian captivity: “As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.”

In captivity we watched in vain for a nation that could not save us, the very vain help Isaiah warned of. And the same thing is happening to us today. That is why the Most High says, “Their strength is to sit still”, and why it was written in a table and noted in a book “for the time to come for ever and ever”.

precepts.text: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us. This is why we do not put our hope in marching, voting, or getting into office; we wait on the Most High to save us.
precepts.point: The verse names a people who were possessed, sold, and slain by those who held themselves not guilty, and whose own shepherds do not pity them. That is Israel, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics, and Native Americans.

note.label: Zechariah 11: The Flock of the Slaughter and the Two Staves

precepts.why:
The flock of the slaughter, possessed, sold and slain by those who hold themselves not guilty, whose own shepherds pity them not, is Israel: the so-called Blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans. “As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.”

This is why we do not put our hope in marching, voting or getting into office. Our eyes have failed watching for a nation that could not save us; we wait on the Most High to save us.

note.label: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality

precepts.why:
“Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks?” God gave the beautiful peacock feathers. “or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?” He gave the ostrich her wings and feathers too.

“Which leaveth her eggs in the earth”. The silly ass woman leaves her eggs there. “and warmeth them in dust”. She sits on them to warm them so they'll hatch. “And forgetteth that the foot may crush them”. Then the same ostrich gets up and smashes the damn egg after warming it. That's the mentality the world wants our women in. Where's the radicalness to stop this? The sea monster must feed and take care of its babies. Animals have better damn sense than we do.

Now they are moving to lynching. Remember, before that it was police killing. That is not going to stop. That is the only way the Most High God is going to get our people to change.

You notice the so-called black leaders, none of them talk about this. You notice the black church do not talk about this. They pretend that it is not happening. Let us just pretend it is not happening, maybe it will go away. I got news for you. These white people who is lynching these people, guess what they are? They are Christians. White nationalist Christians. That is who they are. And the black Christian church do not say nothing. None of these so-called mega churches, none of the so-called mega pastors say nothing. Everybody is shush. Do not say nothing, it will go away.

You ain't seen nothing yet. The Most High God is about to turn the heat on our people. You see what is going on with the Haitians right now? That is not going to stop. Some of you think what is going on with the Haitians right now is only Donald Trump doing it. But guess what? Donald Trump is going to leave. Somebody is coming in. They are going to make it worse for the Haitians. It is not going to change. You see what is going on with the southern kingdom. The so-called Cubans in Miami was singing, let us vote for Donald Trump. Now Donald Trump is deporting them to Africa, where they do not know nobody. That is not going to stop.

As for us — the us is the Israelites. As for the Israelites, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help. You see, our eyes failed for vain help. We seeking justice in an unjust system. That is our people. We cry, we march, we scream, we boycott. At the end of the day, you go merry Christmas, you go happy Thanksgiving. All those hollering and crying mean nothing. On Sunday, what did you do? You go back to the same slave master you crying for justice against. You are mentally insane.

You know what we compare to? It is like a pig with a bow tie. You can clean it. You can put a diamond chain on a pig's neck. The pig will go back to the dirt again. You can buy the most expensive perfume, put it on a pig, he will go back again. That is some of us. We refuse to change. No matter how much they murder us, raping, no matter how much they have done to us, we went back to them again.

In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us. We are watching for a country that could not save us. We are watching for an unjust system to give us justice. You want the rapist to convict itself. You tell the man who rapes, steals, murders — you want him to go to court and convict himself. That is not going to happen.
I always said America built the perfect system. You know why it is the perfect system? Because it is their system, it is not ours. The system is against us.

We are still talking about the lynching that is going on. Some of you, you are praying for this to stop. No, I am praying for this to continue. Because what they are doing right now is they are trying to start a race war. That is what this is. You guys cannot see what is about to happen. And guess what? Your government is not doing a damn thing about it. Donald Trump and his government never said a damn thing about it. The media stay quiet about it. It is people in social media who is talking. And it is not only down south, it is going all over the country. The president of the United States acts like it is not happening. The media acts like it is not happening.
And they are not going to say nothing.

They hunt our steps. Is there any difference in Babylon of old and Babylon the great today, or the virgin daughter of Babylon? It's the exact same thing.

That we cannot go in our streets. The Bible is very descriptive. This is who we're trusting in. We're trusting in the hunters. Sonya Massey called the hunters. Put her picture up on the screen. The hunter threatened her: if you don't put that down, I'm going to shoot you in your effing face. Meanwhile, she's the one that called them for assistance. She called them for assistance. And being the merciless people that they are, that they're created to be, they did exactly what he said he was going to do right there.
As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us. We watched for this nation to help us, but they not going to save us.

They said one of them is a trillionaire, and you got billionaires on top of billionaires here. You telling me they can't help us? They could help us, but they're not going to, because it ain't in their spirit to do it.

God got us going through this so we can get through that great tribulation and make it to the kingdom of heaven. We got to go through these trials, these rough paths, these hard times, so we can make it back to the father, because we departed from him. Now he bringing us back, and we must go through this to show ourselves faithful to the Lord.

points: The gold has become dim and the most fine gold changed; the stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the top of every street, and the precious sons of Zion, once comparable to fine gold, are now esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the potter's hands.

Even the sea monsters draw out the breast and give suck to their young, but the daughter of the people is become cruel like the ostrich in the wilderness; the tongue of the suckling cleaves to the roof of his mouth for thirst, and the young children ask bread and no man breaks it to them.

They that fed delicately are desolate in the streets, and they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills, for the punishment of the iniquity of the people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment.
The famine of the siege was so severe that a nation once raised in the finest things was reduced to nothing, and their judgment for their sin exceeded even the sin of Sodom.
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, whiter than milk, more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing of sapphire, but their visage is now blacker than a coal, and they are not known in the streets.

The verse says their visage is blacker than a coal, which shows plainly that the Israelites are a black people; the coal is the natural color of the nation and the burning of the famine only made it darker.
They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger, for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

The hands of the pitiful women sodden their own children for meat in the destruction of the people, and the Most High accomplished His fury and poured out His fierce anger, kindling a fire in Zion that devoured its foundations.

The kings of the earth and all the inhabitants of the world would not have believed that the adversary and enemy could enter the gates of Jerusalem, but it came to pass for the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests that shed the blood of the just in her midst.
They wandered as blind men in the streets, polluted with blood so that men could not touch their garments, and the people cried unto them, Depart, it is unclean, depart.

The anger of the Most High divided them and He would no more regard them; they respected not the persons of the priests and favored not the elders, for the leadership that was supposed to guide the people had defiled itself.
Their eyes failed watching for a vain help; they watched for a nation that could not save them, looking to other countries to deliver them instead of to the Most High.

Their persecutors were swifter than the eagles of heaven, pursuing them upon the mountains and laying wait for them in the wilderness, so that they could not go in their streets and their end was come.
The breath of their nostrils, the anointed of the Most High, was taken in their pits, the very one under whose shadow they thought to live among the heathen.
Edom is told to rejoice and be glad in the land of Uz, but the cup shall pass through unto her also; she shall be drunken and make herself naked, for her turn of judgment is coming.
The punishment of the iniquity of Zion is accomplished and the Most High will no more carry her away into captivity, but He will visit the iniquity of Edom and discover her sins.

“Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones”. This is the black community we about to read about. Even sea monsters feed their little babies. “the daughter of my people is become cruel”. The Israelite women, the nation of Israel, is completely effed up. “like the ostriches in the wilderness.” Cruel like the ostrich, won't feed the babies. We throw our babies down garbage disposals and abort them. I haven't known a sea monster to abort its babies. Even the sea monsters have better sense.

That mother cat watching the hawk and owl had a circumspect eye for danger. She wanted her kitten to grow up. She moved the kitten out of the owl's way, got into a stance, and flew at the enemy. You will not kill my baby. That cat was radical. Anger made her defend her young. Where is that radicalness to stop what's happening to our children? Only our people have this dope needle of Christianity thinking in our brains, going into that dome of crack called a church. That cat wasn't turning the other cheek.
